name: Pet Clicker Mania!
desc:
🖱️ Clicker Simulator
Welcome to Clicker Simulator, the ultimate pet-filled clicking adventure! Tap to gain clicks, hatch powerful pets, explore epic zones, and climb your way to the top of the leaderboards! 💥

Collect rare pets, unlock new worlds, and become the most powerful clicker in Roblox!

🆕 LATEST UPDATE
🗺️ 3 New Zones added
🏠 Brand-new Main Lobby redesign
🐾 Several New Pets to hatch and collect
🛹 Hoverboards Coming Soon! (Stay tuned!)

⚙️ FEATURES
🐶 Pet Hatching: Discover common to mythical pets

🔁 Rebirths: Reset your clicks for massive boosts

🤝 Trading: Swap pets with other players

🏆 Leaderboards: Show off your stats and become #1

🐞 In-Game Bug Reports: Found a bug? Report it easily!

🧾 Codes (Coming Soon!): Get free rewards with special codes

🔥 Start clicking, hatching, and dominating the zones now in Clicker Simulator!
👍 Like and favorite for more updates!
